# FootyAgent

> FootyAgent is a single-player football agent management game for iPhone and iPad (iOS/iPadOS 17.0 or later). You play as a players' agent, not a coach: scout talents, negotiate agent contracts, wages, playing time and transfers, and grow your agency. Free, no ads, playable offline, no account needed. Developer: Florian Schlauf (Germany). Current version 1.2.10.

- [Scouting](https://footyagent.app/features/scouting/): Find talent – and see through the uncertainty.
- [Negotiations](https://footyagent.app/features/negotiations/): Commission, playing time, contract length and wages.
- [Transfers & loans](https://footyagent.app/features/transfers/): Offers, pitching clients to clubs and loan deals.
- [Agency management](https://footyagent.app/features/agency-management/): Office, staff, licences, specialisations, club shares.
- [Offline play](https://footyagent.app/offline-football-game/): What works without internet (everything that matters).

- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6790972595): Download

## Facts

- Platforms: iPhone, iPad
- Price: free (optional one-time Pro Pack, no gameplay advantage)
- Languages: English, German, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), French, Italian, Turkish and Polish
- World: 17 nations, 26 leagues, 480 clubs (fictional players, clubs named after cities)
- Released: 2026-08-17
